change.description: Restore historical list-cover rendering while limiting the unwatermarked public media contract to list cover/card; detail covers, source descriptors, body, attachments, and playback retain their watermark paths and candidates.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible public media compatibility fix. It changes list cover presentation and role-specific asset selection without changing routes, persistent state, or non-list watermark behavior.

current.reasoning: The candidate restores object-cover list cards and related-card hover behavior, keeps detail/body/attachment/playback and source-descriptor watermark candidates, migrates legacy cover/card paths only, and makes the official SSR Web Demo resolve local media derivatives instead of serving the favicon fallback.

scope_drift.description: No scope drift; the candidate remains limited to public cover media selection, historical snapshot compatibility, list presentation, fixtures, tests, and their release evidence.

verified.reasoning: Focused contract, compatibility, package logic, static build and page-output verification, plus official SSR Web Demo validation verify a reversible role-scoped media fix with no persistent-state migration. The local guest E2E command remains host-blocked by the Linux/amd64 embedded search module on macOS; CI remains authoritative for that gate. The release-only media packager also requires the configured remote media origin, while the local static output path contract was verified directly.
